statement: ∃ (C c X : ℝ), 0 < C ∧ 0 < c ∧ 0 < X ∧ ∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → ⌈X⌉₊ ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n : ℝ) / (Nat.totient q : ℝ)| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(c * Real.sqrt (Real.log (n : ℝ))))

brief.zh: 把冻结题 L-goldbach-fixed-ap-bmor-psi 的误差形状从 n/(840·log n) 放宽到经典 Siegel–Walfisz 形状 C·n·exp(-c√log n)，常数与阈值存在量化。此形式已经是机器核验的定理：由已移植的 Siegel–Walfisz（kimihiro64/bombieri-vinogradov，Apache-2.0，730 个模块、2.87 MiB 源码）经本项目已验证的装配层直接得到，`#print axioms` 仅 propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound。证明的依赖闭包为 2.87 MiB，是单文件 2 MiB 上限的 1.44 倍，故本任务需要 imports 白名单（参考 lean-eval #1971 的 vendored-closure 先例与 #3815 的 imports 机制）。冻结题本身（1/840、n ≥ 8·10⁹）仍受数值证书约束，见 Discussion #3817。
brief.en: Relax the frozen task's error shape from n/(840·log n) to the classical Siegel–Walfisz shape C·n·exp(-c√log n), with existentially quantified constants and threshold. This form is already a machine-checked theorem: it follows from a ported Siegel–Walfisz formalization (kimihiro64/bombieri-vinogradov, Apache-2.0; 730 modules, 2.87 MiB of source) through our verified assembly layer, with `#print axioms` = propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. The proof's import closure is 2.87 MiB, 1.44x the single-file 2 MiB limit, so this task needs an imports whitelist (cf. the vendored-closure precedent in lean-eval #1971 and the imports mechanism in #3815). The frozen task itself (1/840, n ≥ 8·10⁹) remains certificate-bound; see Discussion #3817.
